{
  "name": "bt_rx_desc_complete",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "docstring": "Completes a received Bluetooth RX descriptor by clearing it, copying frame and status metadata into an allocated HCI event buffer, sending the event, and issuing a follow-up HCI command.",
  "subsystem": "bt",
  "var_renames": {
    "v0": "rx_desc",
    "v1": "bt_ctl",
    "v2": "rx_status",
    "v3": "event_params",
    "v4": "hci_evt_buf",
    "v5": "desc_ptrs",
    "v6": "frame_len"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 4, "meaning": "low pointer or descriptor reference stored in RX descriptor"},
    {"offset": 8, "meaning": "second descriptor pointer/metadata reference read with the low descriptor word"},
    {"offset": 12, "meaning": "RX status byte copied into controller state"},
    {"offset": 14, "meaning": "RX descriptor valid/ownership byte cleared when the descriptor is completed"},
    {"offset": 32, "meaning": "controller status field updated from the RX status byte"}
  ]
}
